source: GPT-6 Astra through the Codex Chrome plugin (user Chrome, profile Runiir), 2026-09-27; verbatim extraction output
notes: Read rendered innerText in one new tab in the already-running Chrome profile Runiir. All six fight pages showed Maloriak Normal (10 Player), Kill; encounter 1025, zone 1023.

Three primary Fire Mage references: Mapiti 52, Mugiwaraya 50, Halinor 50. Three primary Assassination Rogue references: Duskstep 49, Mastabator 57, Teabo 48. These are the displayed fight Parse % values, not ranking-list positions. Salcilia 78 and Rîzla 70 were also present and are included as additional players, not middle-percentile reference selections.

Default Phase 2 damage tables state: Damage done to Aberrations and Prime Subjects is excluded in the P2 partition. Damage done to non-boss enemies during Phase 2 is excluded. raid_dps, damage, dps_all and ability breakdowns use the rendered View Unfiltered Damage link (options=8192) so all-target damage is included. Percentiles come from the default ranking-filtered view. Boss-only DPS comes from the Maloriak target filter.

Damage amounts retain the displayed k/m rounding. Duplicate ability names and parenthesized hit counts are preserved as displayed. Hidden collapsed pet child rows were omitted; the visible Mirror Image aggregate is included.

Null ability casts or uptime means the damage table displayed a dash. The casts dictionaries reproduce only rows shown in the Casts view; missing abilities, including Envenom, have not been inferred from damage hits.
dps_boss_only is null for specs other than Fire Mage and Assassination Rogue because it was not requested for them.

Suebi appears in the ZyH2KkjchMRTdXga summary as a Restoration Druid healer at item level 358, but is absent from the unfiltered damage table. Damage, DPS and actor ID are null rather than inferred as zero.

Guild is null for XzVpNLkxaAFG3DjW and 3pvXdMVntcjxygW4 because the report headers show Personal Logs. Their realm values come from the selected players ranking entries, not a claim that every raid member shares that realm.

date uses the ranking-entry kill date with the report year. report_date_display preserves the report creation date. Mapiti ranks on Oct 1 in a report created Sep 30; Halinor ranks on Oct 11 in a report created Oct 10 and the fight header shows 12:04 AM.

p2_transition_sec is the Release All Minions completed Cast event timestamp. Both Begin Cast and Cast timestamps are retained in release_all_minions_events; this avoids inferring an exact health-threshold crossing.
